decision: Treat a new key under a remote include nested in another remote include as a refusal (exit 3), not an override placed further out
options: write the override in the nearest local file
reason: Step 5 D-40 puts the override in the nearest including file, which is remote here; refusing cannot lose data and the message names the local include line

decision: A file: include inside remote content stops loading (exit 4)
reason: Resolving on disk would let a remote document pull local files in; resolving against the URL is a URL include the contract does not describe; refusing is the cautious choice

decision: Fetch each URL once per command and reuse the fetched content for set's re-check
reason: A command must see one consistent configuration, and a set must not fail because the server changed between reads

decision: Fetch behaviour: follow redirects, accept only a 2xx final status, 10-second limit, no authentication, no cache, no retries
reason: The contract only defines 'a failed fetch'; these are the plainest choices, each held in one place

decision: Look up literals only through properties/additionalProperties/items; treat format as an annotation (not checked); refuse schema $refs that leave the document
reason: The contract names the three keywords; asserting formats would reject configurations the default 2020-12 vocabulary accepts; the schema then never causes a fetch

decision: Record remote changes as file changes (via file, unknown actor) at the next reconcile; watch does not poll URLs
reason: Step 2 D-10 compares the configuration, not the files; a new via value is not in the contract

decision: !literal on a non-string scalar gives its text as a string; on a mapping or list it gives exit 4
reason: The tag means take literally; a collection cannot be a literal string, and guessing would hide a mistake

decision: show prints literals as plain strings; set keeps an existing !literal tag when it replaces the value
reason: show prints the resolved configuration; keeping the tag is the smallest diff and harmless

decision: --include on a path the schema marks format: uri is refused (exit 3)
reason: The schema says the value is a literal, so writing an include would silently not do what was asked

decision: Include-like strings inside a mapping or list VALUE are tagged too
reason: Otherwise a collection VALUE would create includes that get fetched

decision: Messages show the include string 'exactly as written': the scalar's text between its quotes, not normalised
reason: The user can then find it in the file by searching

decision: Number step 7 as FR-600+, D-60 to D-70 and SC-600+, following earlier steps
reason: Follow the numbering of the earlier steps

decision: Settle open points without asking the owner (no clarification markers)
reason: Principle V

decision: List the breaking change (plain URL strings become includes) under Assumptions and document it in the README
reason: It follows directly from the contract

decision: Deliver on main with no feature branch, no push, no PR
reason: Same as the earlier steps

decision: Keep the include vocabulary (prefixes, !literal, REF_KEY, include_ref) in a new module includes.py
reason: Principle IV; avoids an import cycle and keeps the literal rule from being spread out

decision: Widen SourceFile.path to Path | str and send every write through local_path so mypy enforces read-only remote content
reason: The type system enforces FR-610 at every write site; the other options need extra branches, collapse //, or have to refuse on many routes

decision: Fetch with urllib from the standard library, using a total deadline read in chunks, strict UTF-8, and proxies from the environment
reason: Keeps dependencies short; a total deadline is what the 10-second limit means

decision: Decide YAML vs text from the URL path only (ignoring query and fragment), case-sensitive, reusing YAML_SUFFIXES; compare URLs as written for cycles
reason: Same rule as file: targets, held in one constant

decision: Pass each node's subschema down while building so literals are decided before any fetch
reason: A first pass would already have fetched URLs that must not be fetched

decision: Validate inside load(), reusing set's reload check for exit 3; watch also snapshots the schema file
reason: Every command goes through load; validating per command means five call sites, and one could be forgotten

decision: Find the include line for a remote refusal by walking PATH (outermost local remote include on the route)
options: remember the first include site per URL in the loader
reason: The same URL can be included twice; PATH decides the route

decision: Mark include-like VALUE strings before planning (literals.mark) and write the tag in the renderer only
reason: Six routes; a missed one would write an untagged URL that then gets fetched

decision: Skip only the !literal tag in content_start (other explicit tags keep step 1 behaviour)
reason: So a replacement keeps the tag (FR-644)

decision: Add --include as a store_true flag on set, like the earlier set flags
reason: Same shape as the two earlier set flags (step 5 D-52)

decision: Label remote values in show --sources with their URL; leaves/reconcile unchanged
Test against a real local HTTP/HTTPS server with an openssl self-signed certificate, and drop proxy variables
reason: Principle II asks for real responses; monkeypatching can't reach the child process

decision: Add jsonschema>=4.23 as the 2020-12 validator
reason: It is the reference implementation; a hand-written validator is a large invented surface

decision: Break the plan into 27 tasks by user story, tests first; MVP is Phases 1–3, with US2 next and US3 before US4/US5
reason: US3 tests need real fetching; US4/US5 need US3's schema loading

decision: Add types-jsonschema as a dev dependency (beyond the task list)
reason: jsonschema ships no type information; keeps mypy --strict meaningful

decision: Alias expansion keeps !literal tags in the copy (beyond the task list)
reason: Otherwise a literal URL in the copy becomes an include and the re-check refuses the set

decision: Reject a $schema other than 2020-12 and a non-object schema document (exit 4)
Report only the best_match validation error, with the dotted path or 'the top level'
Also refuse $dynamicRef pointing outside the schema, not just $ref
Remote YAML that fails to parse is reported naming the including file too
reason: The user can change only that file (FR-602)

decision: Also drop SSL_CERT_FILE and lowercase/ALL_PROXY variables from the test environment
reason: Proxy variables would route the fixture server's requests elsewhere

decision: Test server stall of 15 s and 64 KiB read chunk size
reason: The stall must be longer than the 10-second fetch limit

decision: !literal on a folded scalar strips the '\a' placeholder ruamel leaves in the text
Fix two own step 7 test schemas by removing type: string where includes produce mappings
reason: Once validation was added, those configurations correctly failed

decision: Update five step 1 tests to pass --include rather than change behaviour
reason: Under step 7 file: values are written !literal by default; the tests keep proving what an include written by set does

decision: Adjust test expectations to step 1's comment-column rule (FR-036)
reason: The expectations ignored the step 1 comment-column rule

decision: Treat the unreproducible sixth failure as a probable timing flake and continue
reason: It did not recur in reruns or the final full run; that run overlapped the manual walk-through

decision: Reorder the quickstart so the URL setting is added after the remote reads
reason: It added a URL setting before the schema existed, and that setting was fetched as an include

decision: Convergence: add T028–T032 for five gaps, with severities (CRITICAL untested behaviours, HIGH watch polling, MEDIUM --include refusal, LOW nested failure message, LOW unrecorded decisions)
reason: Constitution II/VI, D-65, FR-644, FR-602

decision: Remove the redundant $ref branch in remote.py found by a break check
reason: The loader already points included_by at the $ref value

decision: Introduce FetchError(LoadError); watch retries failed fetches only after a local or schema file changes, while broken local files are still retried on every poll
reason: D-65 says watch does not poll URLs; keep step 2 D-13 behaviour

decision: --include removes the tag on block/empty values; a literal block keeps its indicator (a: |- with the include as content), differing from the task wording
reason: Step 1 FR-030 requires the block to keep its style

decision: Fix the bug where an empty !literal value set without --include failed, by skipping the tag in _after_properties
reason: FR-644 requires the tag to be kept

decision: Nested fetch failures add 'included through <string> at line N of <file>'; move as_written to tree.py
reason: FR-602; avoid an import cycle

decision: Record implementation decisions as research U-13
reason: Constitution VI

decision: Treat the SC-606 wording mismatch as CRITICAL and append task T033 rather than editing the spec during convergence
reason: The constitution requires spec, code and tests to agree; the convergence step only appends tasks

decision: Reword SC-606 to state the exception and add a note under step 1 FR-025 pointing to FR-640
reason: So a reader of step 1 finds why its set behaviour changed

decision: Do not rerun the full test suite after the spec-only T033 change
reason: Only spec wording changed
